content: Abi yacnoshon ambi uaidon Icbombo Esuquidistu nendac

Ëndenquimboshë Nuquin Papan ëmbi chiacpadomboen chuibanta cac adomboembidi abëd icquido tsusedpabon chuibanoapampic. Abentsëc chuimeshun yuecshun ambi chiaid utsi tsusedpa utsitsen chuimeoapampic. Adoshombic yuecquiocshon ambi chiaid utsitsen tsusedpa utsitsen chuimeoapampic. Adembidi ambi abi yacnoshon uaid mayan bëda budmiac aidën chiacpadomboen tsusedpabon chuioapampic. Adembidi nadatiambocquin uabanquin ismequin chiac adomboembidi chuioapampic.

Nëbi tsyuecquio Nuquin Papan chiacpadomboen abipadquiocquidëmbi aton Madon chuibanec. Aidi Nuquin Papan ambi uaido con icbo camiaidquio nec. Nidaid abubëdta uashun aidënquiocquidtedi aton Papabëdtan uabanampidquio aton Madombo nec.

Aidi, aton Papa bëdaidquio yampidpadquidquiobidi aton Mado neoaic. Aton Papa yacpadquiocquin ismequid yec ambi nadomboen natiad, quequin nadatiambocquin ambi tantiacpadquiequi nidaid abubëd aidënquiocquidtedi adquiouidi iquec. Aidi aton Papan chiaid niaquesambo yec matses icsaid bedshunash abided cuidadec unësash, Ëmbi bëdambocquid icmebanaido matses nendac, quequin tantiashic abuc nidoash Nuquin Papabëd tabadoapanëdash aidquiobi.
Ad icnuc ambi abi yacnoshon uaido abipadquid nibëdec. Aidon con Icbombo caidquio nec.
¿Ambi abi yacnoshon uaid mayan bëda isec:

content.text: “Con mado mibi nec.
Ëbi min papa nendac, quepecta Nuquin Papa iquec? Padenquio.
¿Nëidën Papa nebi.
Adecbidi: Con mado nec, quepecta Nuquin Papa iquec aido caic? Padenquio.”

content: Abëd Abiambo Yampidi nidaidën tabadash choasho isun Nuquin Papan ismequin:

content.text: “Nëid con Madombo Abentsëqui nec. Aidquio tantiec con Icbo nec, quec cuishon quec, ambi naid chiec cuëdën, cac aden ambi abi yacnoshon uaido mayan bëdabo chuibanec cuëdëncuededendac.”

content: Ambi abi yacnoshon uaido mayan bëdabo naden Nuquin Papan chiec:

content.text: “Ëmbi chiacpadequi cunquequid yanec.
Adecbidi, ëmbi chiacpadequi cuëte nëdënquedote iquendac.”

content: Padnuen ambi uacmaid abipadquid aton Madombo utsi uatiapimbo iquec. Adquidquio icsho Nuquin Papan naden chiec:

content.text: “Ënenquiocquin ëbëdtan Chuiquid Abentsëcquio mibi iquendac.
Adecbidi namequid bëdaidquio mibi iquendac.
Ëbipadquid iquec bëdamboec tabadquin nabante bunquidquio mibi nec. Adquid yec icsamboec tabadquin nabante bunesambobidi mibi nec.
Adquid yec ëbi yacpadquidquio Icbo Abentsëcquiobi mibi nec. Mibëd icquido adquid nibëdec.
Mibi abentsëqui adquidquio iquec. Adquid iquec, Bëdambo iquebi, quec mibi cuishon quendac.”

content: Adembidi Nuquin Papan naden aton Mado chuioaic,

content.text: “Tauamboen nidaid abubëdta uashun aidënquiocquidtedi mimbi uabampampic.
Aidtedishun icbombo mibi nec.
Aidtedi ënëdendac.
Mibien nibëdantiapimbo yec abi tabadendac.
Aidtedi dashcute shënibudaid niacbimboen chuca uaindac.
Mibien Abiambo Yampid yec abi ënëdesa mibi iquendac.
Nëbi cainec ëbëdquio tabadec cho.
Mibi chieshënquidtedi nibëdquio icmenun nabono. Chiata,”

content: quequin Nuquin Papan chiampic. ¿Ambi abi yacnoshon uaido mayan bëda aden chuipampidta nepadic? Padenquio. Esuquidistu aden chuipampic.
Ambi abi yacnoshon uaido mayan bëdabo Nuquin Papan, Ëbëd tabadtequidombo nashunta, caido nec.
